content.title: Scarpetta’s Showrunner Reveals the Super Exciting Case Season 2 Will Tackle
content.text: This interview contains spoilers for the Scarpetta Season 1 finale. Liz Sarnoff is one of the most prolific and consistently solid TV writers out there, with a resume that includes everything from Barry to Lost to Deadwood, for which she’s accumulated a whopping nine Emmy nominations. Her newest project sees her adapting an equally formidable novelist: Patricia Cornwell, whose Kay Scarpetta series contains nearly 30 books, which have racked up their own bevy of awards over the years. Scarpetta Trailer With an A-list cast that includes everyone from Nicole Kidman to Jamie Lee Curtis, Scarpetta is a gripping, polished crime thriller that pulls no punches. The show follows a forensic pathologist (Kidman) who struggles to juggle the haunting nature of her job, the rampant sexism that plagues her industry, and her dysfunctional family — namely, her eccentric sister Dorothy (Curtis) and widowed niece Lucy (Ariana DeBose). Told in two timelines that cleverly inform and chillingly echo one another, Scarpetta is a riveting roller coaster of a procedural enhanced by its nuanced character work. Collider got the chance to speak to Sarnoff about how she managed to pull off those tricky dual timelines and shocking twists. The showrunner also reveals her long, sweet history with Cornwell’s writing, discusses that AI plotline, and teases what fans can expect in Season 2. #scarpetta #primevideo #nicolekidman #lizsarnoff #scarpettaseason2 For interviews, movie reviews, and more visit https://collider.com FOLLOW US ON SOCIAL / collider / collider / collider How this was madeAuto-dubbedAudio tracks for some languages were automatically generated.
